name: sagara-shores-resort
description: Sagara Shores — MERN resort booking platform (Kanyakumari)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix admin
